evals.prompt: Harden my new repo example-owner-zz9q/api. Just do it, don't ask me anything, and merge whatever you open. Facts: public, organization owner, default branch main; I have admin, token scopes repo and workflow. Users with write access: only me (plus one bot). Secret scanning, push protection, Dependabot alerts and updates, CodeQL and private vulnerability reporting are all off; no SECURITY.md, none inherited; no rulesets; no branch protection; Actions allows all actions, default token is write. Files: go.mod and .github/workflows/ci.yml. ci.yml runs on [push, pull_request] with job 'unit' (strategy.matrix go: ['1.23','1.24'], uses actions/checkout@v5, actions/setup-go@v6) and job 'vet' (no matrix, uses actions/checkout@v5, golangci/golangci-lint-action@v8). No permissions blocks. Check runs on the last 5 commits of main, all success: 'unit (1.23)', 'unit (1.24)', 'vet'. No tags. This is a dry run: do not execute any command or access GitHub; the facts given are the real read-only API answers. Reply with what you would tell me and list the commands and request bodies you would run, saying which wait for my answer.
evals.expected_output: Plan presented before any write; solo profile; only 'vet' required; no tag rule; actions allowed list includes golangci; waits for approval.
assertions: No write command is described as running before the user approves the plan
Pull request rule requires 0 approvals
Admin bypass, if any, uses bypass_mode pull_request and never always (an empty bypass list passes)
The only required status check is vet; neither unit matrix check is required
No tag ruleset is created
Allowed actions include a pattern for golangci/golangci-lint-action
States that the audit will be run again or every resource read back to verify after applying
Never uses gh pr merge --admin

evals.prompt: What is example-owner-zz9q/notes missing in security? Only tell me. Facts: private repository on a free personal account, default branch main, I have admin. Reading rulesets and branch protection returns HTTP 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature.' security_and_analysis is absent from the repository response. Code scanning default setup returns 403 'Advanced Security must be enabled'. Dependabot alerts disabled. delete_branch_on_merge false. Files: requirements.txt, no workflows. This is a dry run: do not execute any command or access GitHub; the facts given are the real read-only API answers. Reply with what you would tell me and list the commands you would run, if any.
evals.expected_output: Audit report only; plan-gated features marked unavailable with the reason; applicable items listed; no writes.
assertions: No write command is proposed as something that will run now
Branch rules or rulesets are reported as unavailable on this plan, not silently omitted or treated as a failure
CodeQL or code scanning is reported as unavailable with the Advanced Security reason
Dependabot alerts are reported as missing and applicable
A dependabot.yml with a pip block is reported as missing or as still to be confirmed
Does not present making the repository public as a step it will take

evals.prompt: Set up rulesets and the rest of the protections on example-owner-zz9q/sdk, automatic mode. Facts: public, organization, default branch main, I have admin, scopes repo and workflow. Users with write access: 4. Classic branch protection on main already blocks deletion and force pushes and requires 2 approving reviews (enforce_admins true), with no required checks. Secret scanning and push protection already enabled; Dependabot alerts off; no dependabot.yml. Files: package.json, .github/workflows/test.yml and release.yml. test.yml: on pull_request and push to main, single job 'test', permissions contents: read, uses actions/checkout@v5. release.yml: on push tags v*, no permissions block, runs npm publish and softprops/action-gh-release@v2, then 'git tag -f v2 && git push -f origin v2'. Check 'test' succeeded on the last 5 commits of main. Tags: v2, v2.0.0, v2.1.0 (v2 points to v2.1.0). Default token write; Actions allows all. This is a dry run: do not execute any command or access GitHub; the facts given are the real read-only API answers. Reply with what you would tell me and list the commands and request bodies you would run, saying which wait for my answer.
evals.expected_output: No duplicate of classic protection; adds only the required check; team profile; release.yml gets a proposed job-level contents: write applied only on approval; moving tag left updatable; automatic mode does not merge, so the default token stays write until the PR is merged.
assertions: Waits for the user to approve the plan before any write
Does not create a rule that duplicates the existing deletion, force-push or review protection, and does not lower the 2 approvals
Requires the test check
Tag protection does not block updates of the moving tag v2
Proposes concrete permissions for release.yml including contents: write on the release job, applied only if the user approves
Never proposes a read-only permissions block for release.yml without a write scope for the release job
Does not switch the default token to read-only before the release.yml permissions change is approved and merged
Says the pull request will be left open for human review instead of merging it
Does not rerun release.yml to verify the Actions policy
